title: EukaUTR: a foundation model unifying functional modelling and design of eukaryotic 3 ′ UTRs
authors: Lang M; Fang X; Chen M; Wang Z; Cheng Z; Zhu X; Tam KY; Zhang J; Li X
one_liner_zh: 该文构建了真核生物3'UTR序列的基础模型，用于功能预测和序列设计，但研究对象是RNA非编码区，不涉及蛋白质结构计算，与本课题无关。
abstract: Eukaryotic mRNA 3 ′ UTRs encode regulatory information that shapes post-transcriptional control, RNA fate and gene expression. However, a 3 ′ UTR-specific foundation model that spans broad eukaryotic sequence diversity while supporting both functional prediction and sequence design is lacking. Here we present EukaUTR, a 3 ′ UTR-specific foundation model trained on a large-scale eukaryotic 3 ′ UTR sequence corpus spanning diverse evolutionary lineages. Across 13 prediction tasks spanning post-transcriptional regulation, RNA fate and expression output, EukaUTR models matched or exceeded the strongest external baselines on nearly all tasks, with relative improvements of up to 27.45%. EukaUTR also generated de novo 3 ′ UTRs with natural-like sequence and regulatory properties. EukaUTR-Guide further derived stability-associated signals from small sequence sets to guide editing towards enhanced predicted stability. Together, EukaUTR provides a sequence-to-function-to-design framework for transferable 3 ′ UTR modelling and design.
abstract_zh: 真核mRNA 3′UTR编码调控信息，塑造转录后调控、RNA命运和基因表达。然而，目前缺乏一个跨越广泛真核序列多样性、同时支持功能预测和序列设计的3′UTR特异性基础模型。在此，我们提出EukaUTR，一个基于大规模真核3′UTR序列语料库训练的特异性基础模型，该语料库涵盖多样进化谱系。在涵盖转录后调控、RNA命运和表达输出的13项预测任务中，EukaUTR模型在几乎所有任务上匹配或超越了最强外部基线，相对改进最高达27.45%。EukaUTR还生成了具有自然样序列和调控特性的从头3′UTR。EukaUTR-Guide进一步从少量序列集中提取稳定性相关信号，引导编辑以增强预测稳定性。综上，EukaUTR提供了一个从序列到功能再到设计的框架，用于可迁移的3′UTR建模和设计。
